declared_at: 2026-10-21T04:13Z (written before any jitter unfold was submitted)
authority: director approval of the input-jitter study, 2026-10-20 (after the noise-floor result; binding addendum 11)
status: DESCRIPTIVE. No gate, no re-gating. It cannot revive MP1-A under the frozen PLAN 2.3 rule; it tests whether the G3 curvature is the estimator's response to rounding-scale input changes rather than a hadronic nonlinearity.

inputs.note: the S1 real-data lateral dumps (merged over all 12 playlists, 1A..1P), unchanged; each task re-verifies the dump sha256

unfold.argv: s5p_numerics.py --npz/--bkg (expect sha256) --config R --iters 5 --construction data --pairs=-:<J> --threads 32 (estimator seed the default 42)
unfold.only_change_from_S1: --pairs=-:<J> in place of --pairs=-:-: the edge-safe +-1/2 float32-ulp jitter of every coordinate (s5e_trace.jitter_coords with the grid edges; s5p_numerics refuses with rc 5 if any grid membership changes); the jittered path runs the estimators on float64 coordinates
unfold.pairing: jitter seed J draws the same per-row uniform steps in every variant (each scaled by its own row's ulp), so the five variants at one J are paired
unfold.one_task_per_variant_and_seed: 25 tasks, so that no process runs two unfolds in sequence inside the 30 min limit

compute.layout: one exclusive node per jitter seed, the 5 variants as concurrent srun steps (32 cpus, 56G each)
compute.deadline: anything not complete by 04:00 PDT 2026-10-21 is cancelled and the study is deferred

readout.f: f = U x with U and xs from mp1_s2.u_matrix on the frozen design (404446eb...), exactly as G3

quantities.T_v: sum over the domain of the per-cell sample variance (ddof=1) of f_v over the K jitter seeds, v in {0, s-, s+}
quantities.N_unpaired: sqrt(T_+ + T_- + 4 T_0): the expected second-difference norm (rms) if each unfold carried independent jitter noise of the measured size
quantities.curv_S1: ||f_+ + f_- - 2 f_0|| for the unjittered S1 products (the G3 numerator)
quantities.curv_paired_k: ||f_+,k + f_-,k - 2 f_0,k|| for each jitter seed k (the same jitter seed in all three unfolds)
quantities.curv_jittermean: ||mean_k f_+ + mean_k f_- - 2 mean_k f_0||, compared with N_unpaired / sqrt(K)
quantities.span_k: ||f_+,k - f_-,k|| per jitter seed, and the span of the jitter means
quantities.zero_jitter_vs_S1: ||mean_k f_0,k - f_0,S1|| and the median per-cell relative SD of f_0 over k (descriptive; it mixes the jitter with the float32 -> float64 coordinate change)
reported_ratios: curv_jittermean / span_jittermean (descriptive, the G3 form on jitter means, NOT a gate)

readout.reading_rule: if N_unpaired is of the order of curv_S1 (ratio curv_S1/N_unpaired of order 1, i.e. below about 3), the G3 curvature is read as estimator discreteness under rounding-scale input changes rather than hadronic nonlinearity; if N_unpaired is far below curv_S1 (ratio above about 10), estimator discreteness at this scale is ruled out as the cause; between, undetermined
readout.caveat_declared: with K=5 each T_v carries a chi-square(4) relative uncertainty (about +-70% at 1 sigma on T, +-35% on N); the +-1/2-ulp jitter is far smaller than the +-1 sigma species shifts, so a negative result does not exclude a discreteness response at the scale of the shifts themselves
